title: Her return and the revival of mainstream jazz
summary: She feels her comeback played a part in the upsurge of mainstream jazz after years when swing went underground; the traditionalist-versus-modernist split.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: had something to do with the upsurge in jazz. Mainstream jazz.
Because if you know, in the 60's and before in the last years afterwards, rock was at its peak.
And I supposed anybody -- if you were into jazz, you had to go underground to listen to it.
And also, the jazz world itself was split, I mean, through most of the 1950's, for instance.
